1. According to observations by the Institute, Vein energy has been unusually active in some regions recently, causing unusual changes in the local ecosystem.
2. During the event, the chance of Nova Stage Aniimo appearing will be greatly increased for the first 3 Nurture sessions conducted in the designated area each weekend. After Veinfruit is harvested, the amount of Prismatic Energy gained in the area will receive an additional 50% boost.
Completing Nurture increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy. Capturing Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike, increasing the area’s Prismatic Energy.
· Each time Nurture increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 3% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
· Each time a Lucky Strike triggered while capturing an Aniimo increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 0.6% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
3. Every weekend, abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to gather in the designated area. Pathfinders can head there to explore and capture them.
